historical_interpretation: Secondary held-out-result replay benchmark. The research team confirms that the Agent-selected validation formulation was recommended before its wet-lab result was known to the Agent. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software were formalized later and are reproducible abstractions/operationalizations, not the original contemporaneous freeze artifact.
blindness_definition: The evaluated replay Agent may use original local evidence, the evidence-derived hypothesis, uncertainty-aware actions, and allowed external evidence. It may not see the Agent-selected validation formulation, its thermal-hold measurements, adjudication labels, or controller-side scoring targets.

coordinate_basis.controller_rule: Normalize source-reported validation parts by their own total before any candidate-space comparison.

fine_refinement.historical_interpretation: Current reproducible refinement layer for replay/future prospective use; not claimed as the original historical freeze algorithm.

controller_only_heldout_target.scoring_space: two-dimensional modifier plane in normalized-total wt% coordinates

ranking_contract.rank_2_plus: alternatives_considered in strict descending preference order
ranking_contract.top_3: selected_candidate_id followed by the first two unique valid alternatives

run_protocol.seed_policy: record_if_endpoint_supports_seed; otherwise record run_index and treat calls as repeated stochastic realizations

secondary_region_metrics.note: Controller-side distance scoring is performed only after outputs are frozen. Exact recipe recovery is not a primary metric because the coarse grid is a region benchmark and the validation recipe was reported on a different raw-parts basis.

baselines.description: Primary manuscript baseline: same foundation model, raw original local measurements and candidate compositions only; no state-aware theory, external evidence tools, planner, skeptic, judge or robustness layer.
Chance-level uniform selection from the 12 coarse cells.

interpretation_rules: The 12-cell grid is a coarse region-level replay benchmark, not a claim that the historical recommendation was selected from exactly 12 candidates.
Raw validation parts 17/5 must never be compared directly with normalized-total candidate coordinates; the corresponding controller-side normalized coordinates are approximately 14.00/4.12.
The prospective historical claim attaches to the original Agent recommendation, which the research team confirms preceded knowledge of the validation result.

The current fine-refinement layer is outcome-blind by construction but was formalized later; it supports reproducibility and future prospective design, not retroactive reconstruction of the historical selection algorithm.
Any claim of architecture advantage must be based on repeated blind runs and must report failure, abstention, leakage and scientific-boundary diagnostics alongside recovery metrics.
